disclaimer: Injury and roster statuses reflect the official Week 2 reports through Thursday night, Sept. 17, 2026. Thursday night update: Bills DT Ed Oliver injured his hip in pregame warmups at Detroit and was a surprise inactive - he had not been on the injury report all week and no timeline has been given. Lions CB D.J. Reed (foot), listed Questionable, dressed and is moved back to active; Detroit's ruled-out starters LG Christian Mahogany (hip) and RT Blake Miller (knee) both sat as expected. Earlier Thursday practice movement still stands: Titans LB Cedric Gray (concussion) and Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. (illness) cleared; Buccaneers WR Jalen McMillan (knee) and Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. were full participants; Falcons G Chris Lindstrom (concussion) upgraded to limited; Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) limited a second day (Adam Schefter reported doctors do not believe it is serious, but his Sunday status is in jeopardy). Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was downgraded from limited to no practice. Still not practicing and genuinely in doubt: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) and DE Trey Hendrickson, Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee), Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (ribs), Broncos WR Marvin Mims Jr. (foot), Commanders LB Frankie Luvu (groin) and TE Chig Okonkwo (hamstring), Eagles DT Jalen Carter (wrist), Patriots CB Carlton Davis III (neck), Texans DE Jadeveon Clowney (knee) and Colts WR Alec Pierce (heel). Vikings QB Kyler Murray (concussion) and Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) were both limited again; Murray needs Friday clearance, Burrow expects to start. Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (glute) remains out with no firm timeline, and Atlanta has not named a Week 2 starter with Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) missing practice. Not treated as new injuries: 49ers non-participants Nick Bosa, Christian McCaffrey, Trent Williams and Dre Greenlaw, and Cardinals non-participants Trey McBride, Budda Baker and Josh Sweat, were all confirmed rest days. Official game designations for Sunday games are set on Friday, so statuses can still change - always confirm with the official injury report and inactives before kickoff.

injury.note: Listed as a did-not-participate (knee) on New England's first official injury report Sunday, Sept. 6, but he returned as a full participant on the Monday, Sept. 7 report ahead of Wednesday's opener at Seattle - consistent with local reporting that Sunday doubled as a rest day. No game-status designation has been issued.
The reserve center missed Week 1 with the knee injury but was a limited participant at Wednesday's Week 2 practice, his first practice work of the season.

injury.type: High ankle sprain (right) - on injured reserve
injury.note: Brown hurt the ankle early in the third quarter of the Sept. 9 Kickoff Game at Seattle when Seahawks CB Nehemiah Pritchett's knee came down on it; he limped off and did not return. An MRI confirmed a high ankle sprain and New England placed him on injured reserve Saturday, Sept. 12. Ian Rapoport said on NFL GameDay Morning that Brown is out about six weeks; Adam Schefter had reported he will not need surgery and would miss four to six weeks. He is not eligible to return until Week 6 at the earliest.
Davis was added to New England's report Wednesday, Sept. 16 with a neck injury and did not participate in practice at all on Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. Pittsburgh.

Darnold left the Sept. 9 opener vs. New England after one series; Drew Lock replaced him and won the game. A CT scan ruled out a hip fracture and an MRI ruled out long-term damage, and Ian Rapoport later clarified the injury is to the glute rather than the hip. Seattle has since described it as a 'very unique' soft-tissue injury with no firm timeline for his return. He did not practice Wednesday, Sept. 16 and is not expected to play in Week 2 vs. Arizona.
Emmanwori was a limited participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. Arizona.

Charbonnet tore his ACL in the playoff loss to San Francisco and had surgery in February. Seattle opened camp by placing him on the PUP list July 24, and reporting points to a return around midseason rather than Week 1.

Broke his ankle on Seattle's first defensive snap of the Aug. 23 preseason game at Tennessee and was carted off in an air cast. HC Mike Macdonald said Clark will be out multiple months; the Seahawks placed him on injured reserve Aug. 25 along with OL Mason Richman. The second-round rookie out of TCU had been pushing for the starting free safety job and a significant defensive role.
ir
The Seahawks placed Bobo (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
Okada did not practice at all during Week 1 prep, was listed as OUT and was inactive for the Sept. 9 opener vs. New England.

Kittle was a limited participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. Miami. Nick Bosa, Christian McCaffrey, Trent Williams and Dre Greenlaw were all listed as non-participants on those same reports as designated rest days rather than new injuries.

GM John Lynch announced Pearsall will have surgery on his PCL and is out for the entire 2026 season; placed on injured reserve. Recurring swelling in the same knee had limited him to two camp practices. 49ers re-signed Deebo Samuel in response.

injury.type: Knee soreness / tendinitis (surgically repaired right knee)
injury.note: Cleared entering camp after the ACL surgery that limited him to three games in 2025, but soreness and tendinitis in the repaired right knee cost him several weeks of practice and he sat out the 49ers' first Melbourne session. He was back as a limited participant on the Wednesday, Sept. 9 report with no injury designation listed and is expected to start the Sept. 10 opener vs. the Rams.
Kirk (calf) was placed on injured reserve by the 49ers on Sunday with a designation to return.

Okuayinonu did not fly to Melbourne with the 49ers on Sept. 2 because of a foot injury and was listed as questionable for the opener. San Francisco formally placed him on injured reserve on Friday, Sept. 4, the same day it signed DL Khalid Kareem to a one-year deal (the move appeared in NFL.com's Sept. 5 roundup). A Week 1 IR placement means a minimum four-game absence.

The projected starting defensive tackle tore his patellar tendon at the 49ers' Tuesday, Sept. 8 practice in Melbourne, just before 11-on-11 work. HC Kyle Shanahan confirmed he is out for the 2026 season. A 2025 second-round pick, Collins played all 16 games as a rookie; San Francisco turns to Osa Odighizuwa, CJ West, Gracen Halton and James Thompson Jr. inside.

The rookie was carted off after injuring his ankle in the Week 1 game against the Rams in Melbourne. Initially reported as a deltoid sprain costing him at least a month, he has since undergone ankle surgery and is now expected to miss close to 10 weeks.

injury.type: MCL knee injury - on injured reserve, season-ending
injury.note: Tonges hobbled off during the Sept. 10 win over the Rams in Melbourne with what was later identified as an MCL injury. San Francisco placed him on injured reserve and he is reported to be out for the remainder of the 2026 season, thinning a tight end room already managing George Kittle's Achilles.

injury.type: Knee - arthroscopic surgery, on injured reserve
injury.note: Garrett underwent arthroscopic surgery Monday, Sept. 14 on the knee that bothered him through training camp and is headed to injured reserve, per Tom Pelissero and Ian Rapoport. He played through lower-leg pain in the Week 1 opener in Melbourne and "wasn't himself." HC Sean McVay said Monday there is no timeline for his return and that the Rams had thought the knee was something he could work through. IR sidelines him a minimum of four games - the Giants, Broncos, Eagles and Bills.

Odunze hurt the calf during Chicago's final preseason practice and was limited in all three Week 1 practices. The Bears listed him as questionable on Friday's final report (along with QB Tyson Bagent, S Xavier Woods and OT Ozzy Trapilo), but he told reporters "I'm feeling ready to go" and plans to play at Carolina; HC Ben Johnson said Odunze "looked good" but that the team will weigh the long season.

Swift was a limited participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17 with knee and ankle issues ahead of Sunday vs. Minnesota. RB Kyle Monangai (hamstring) was also limited both days.

injury.type: Hyperextended left knee, bone bruise, small fracture - underwent surgery
injury.note: HC Ben Johnson announced Aug. 11 that Bryant underwent knee surgery and will now miss 4-6 months, a significant setback from the initial 8-10 week outlook (surgery wasn't originally expected). Bears remain hopeful he could be available if Chicago makes the playoffs. Was Chicago's marquee free-agent addition this offseason (3-year, $40M deal).

Opened training camp on the PUP list with a calf injury that also cost him OTAs and minicamp, and GM Ryan Poles cited a frustrating 'delay' in the recovery. Chicago carried him over to the reserve/PUP list to start the season, so he must miss at least the first four games.

Burden strained his groin on Aug. 8 in red-zone one-on-ones and missed the rest of the preseason, but he was left off Chicago's Week 1 injury report entirely and is expected to play at Carolina. Rome Odunze said this week he expects to line up alongside Burden as the Bears' top two receivers.
Monangai (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday's practice.

injury.type: Ruptured patellar tendon (right knee) - surgically repaired
injury.note: Suffered in the Panthers' January playoff loss to the Rams; underwent surgery to repair the tendon. Rehab is reportedly "ahead of schedule" and the Panthers are "really feeling good" about his progress, per team reporting. On PUP to open camp; GM Dan Morgan remains optimistic he can return at some point this season.
Non-contact tear suffered on the first day of training camp practice — out for the season. The injury happened during the mandatory acclimation period, which the NFLPA is investigating.

Diagnosed with a blood clot in his lung in late June and placed on the reserve/non-football injury (NFI) list; immediately started on blood thinners and is reportedly responding well to treatment. Expected to miss the start of the regular season, per ESPN, though the team believes he could return at some point during the year.

Strained the hamstring in one-on-ones in mid-August and has not played in a preseason game. HC Dave Canales said Monday, Aug. 24 that Hubbard is expected to be ready for Week 1, though Carolina isn't rushing him back. Backup Jonathon Brooks has seen expanded preseason reps in the meantime.

Brooks was limited in practice Wednesday and Thursday of Week 1 prep with a groin injury, but practiced fully Friday and came off Carolina's injury report entirely with no game-status designation for the Sept. 13 opener vs. Chicago.
Coker rolled his ankle in the first quarter at Chicago and was in a walking boot Monday, but he called the injury minor and said he expects to play Sunday. He led Carolina in receiving in Week 1.

Missed time late in camp with a toe issue Tampa Bay flagged as a Week 1 roster factor. He practiced fully all week and came off the injury report on Friday, Sept. 11; HC Todd Bowles called him "full-go" for Sunday at Cincinnati.

McMillan was listed as doubtful and did not play in the Week 1 loss at Cincinnati, but he was a full participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. Cleveland. The third-year receiver already lost most of last season to a neck injury.

Burrow was a limited participant with back tightness on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17. He says he first felt it after Sunday's win over Tampa Bay, called it normal game-day soreness, and has made clear he expects to start Sunday at Houston.

Hyperextended the left knee on a catch at the Aug. 25 practice - he called it "just a little tweak" - and missed a week of work. He was a FULL participant with no injury designation on the Wednesday, Sept. 9 report, clearing him for the Sept. 13 opener vs. Tampa Bay.

HC Zac Taylor disclosed a "little heel contusion" on Sept. 1 that cost Higgins that week of practice. He was a FULL participant with no injury designation on the Wednesday, Sept. 9 report ahead of the Sept. 13 opener vs. Tampa Bay.

Kamara sprained his MCL in an August joint practice and was held out of the Sept. 13 opener at Detroit. He was a full participant at Wednesday's practice and HC Kellen Moore said he will play Sunday at Baltimore, adding that Kamara could have played in Week 1 but needed more time on task.

Hurt in the preseason game vs. the Rams; HC Kellen Moore confirmed Tuesday, Aug. 25 that Chandler will miss the entire season, and New Orleans placed him (along with TE Moliki Matavao) on season-ending injured reserve. Compounds a thin backfield with Alvin Kamara out (MCL) and Devin Neal dealing with a hamstring - the Saints traded for RB Zamir White this week in response.

Bresee tore his ACL in an early training-camp practice and was placed on injured reserve Aug. 7 ahead of surgery. He is out for 2026 and targeting full health for 2027; John Ridgeway is expected to start in his place.
Tyson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return by New Orleans on Sunday.
Tipton (leg) is expected to begin the 2026 regular season on the reserve/PUP list, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.
Jordan was ruled OUT for the Sept. 13 loss at Detroit with the hamstring but returned as a limited participant at Wednesday's Week 2 practice ahead of Sunday at Baltimore.

Took a hit to the hip in an Aug. 17 scrimmage and was rested while it calmed down; HC Dan Campbell would not guarantee Week 1, saying "I feel like we'll be OK, but I don't know." LaPorta returned to practice Tuesday, Aug. 25, taking part in both individual and team drills - a strong sign for the Sept. 13 opener vs. New Orleans, though Detroit has not committed and is expected to stay cautious. He is separately fully cleared from November 2025 back surgery.

Still recovering from the Achilles tear he suffered in the first week of December 2025. Detroit placed him on the reserve/PUP list at Sunday's (Aug. 30) cutdown, so he is ineligible for the first four games. With Kerby Joseph also on reserve/PUP, the Lions open the season without both starting safeties.

Detroit placed Joseph on the reserve/PUP list at Sunday's (Aug. 30) cutdown, which rules the All-Pro safety out of at least the first four games. He has been unable to shake a knee injury carried over from last season. He does not count against the 53-man roster while on reserve/PUP.
ir

injury.type: Back - surgery (loose body pressing on a nerve), on injured reserve
injury.note: Detroit placed Pacheco on injured reserve Sept. 1. He underwent surgery Monday, Sept. 14 to remove a loose body that was pressing on a nerve in his back; ESPN reports a recovery of roughly 12 weeks, which points to a return in early December. Jahmyr Gibbs carried the full backfield workload in Week 1.

injury.type: Fractured wrist - on injured reserve, designated to return
injury.note: Mays fractured a small bone in his wrist at the Sunday, Aug. 9 practice; Ian Rapoport reported an eight-to-10-week recovery and HC Dan Campbell said he would miss "significant time" while expecting him back for the playoffs. Detroit placed him on injured reserve with a designation to return at the Aug. 30 cutdown, so he must miss at least the first four games. Mays was the Lions' biggest 2026 free-agent investment, signing a three-year deal in March.

injury.type: Hip (knee injury that migrated to the hip)
injury.note: Detroit's starting left guard did not practice at any point on the short week and was officially ruled OUT for Thursday night at Buffalo. HC Dan Campbell has said it is not a serious long-term issue. Starting RT Blake Miller (knee) was also ruled out, leaving the Lions down two starting offensive linemen.

Reed was added to the report Tuesday, Sept. 15 with a foot issue, was limited all three practices on the short week and was listed Questionable. He was not among Detroit's inactives Thursday night at Buffalo and dressed for the game.
Detroit's starting right tackle did not practice on the short week and was ruled OUT for Thursday night at Buffalo, alongside starting LG Christian Mahogany. No return timeline has been given.

Buffalo's top interior defensive lineman injured his hip during pregame warmups Thursday night at Detroit and was ruled out roughly an hour before kickoff, a surprise scratch after not appearing on the injury report all week. Second-year DL Deone Walker took on a heavy workload in his place. No timeline had been given as of Thursday night.
Shavers (knee) was moved to the reserve/PUP list by the Bills on Sunday.

Suffered a season-ending torn ACL during Tuesday's joint practice with the Raiders, falling awkwardly on a red-zone route in 11-on-11 drills. The 2025 second-round pick started 10 games as a rookie (525 yards, 6 TDs); Houston will lean more on Xavier Hutchinson, Tank Dell and Jaylin Noel in his absence.
The Texans placed Horton (Achilles) on injured reserve Tuesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
Clowney did not participate in practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. Cincinnati.

injury.type: Partially torn plantar fascia (foot) - on injured reserve, designated to return
injury.note: Carted off the Aug. 26 joint practice with Carolina; Adam Schefter reported the next day that Smith injured his plantar fascia. The diagnosis is a partial tear with a four-to-six-week recovery window, and Houston placed Smith on injured reserve as a designated-to-return player alongside fellow T Sam Hagen, per Pro Football Rumors - which rules him out for at least the first four games. GM Nick Caserio confirmed the four-to-six-week timeline. Trent Brown, who had been competing with Smith, takes over as the starting right tackle.

Dell is still working back from the torn ACL and MCL in his left knee and the surgery that followed; Houston had him among its injured players at the Aug. 30 roster deadline. On Friday, Sept. 4 he agreed to a pay cut with the Texans, per Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston - an indication both sides expect him to stay on the roster while he rehabs. No return timetable has been made public.
ir

To'oTo'o hurt the shoulder in the fourth quarter of Sunday's loss to Buffalo and was in a sling afterward. Houston placed him on injured reserve Tuesday, Sept. 15; reporting points to a recovery measured in months for a linebacker who had started 36 straight games.

Collins hurt the hamstring at Wednesday's (Sept. 16) practice and was a limited participant, then went for imaging. He was limited again Thursday, Sept. 17, which is an encouraging sign. Houston does not believe the injury is serious, but his availability for Sunday vs. Cincinnati is still unsettled. He led the Texans with 7 catches for 75 yards and a TD in the Week 1 loss to Buffalo, and a hamstring injury cost him five games in 2024.

injury.type: Left leg injury (no structural damage) - recovered
injury.note: Returned to full practice and 11-on-11 team drills Monday, Aug. 17, after missing most of the prior week following a leg injury suffered tangling feet with WR Ja'Kobi Lane. HC Jesse Minter called the return a positive sign; Wiggins is set to be available for joint practices with Minnesota later this week.

Returned to full practice and 11-on-11 team drills Monday, Aug. 17, after a groin issue sidelined him for several days. HC Jesse Minter said Humphrey bounced back well; on track for Baltimore's joint practices with Minnesota later this week.

Tore the patellar tendon during the Aug. 19 joint practice with the Vikings in Eagan, Minnesota, and was carted off in a full-leg brace. Baltimore placed him on injured reserve Wednesday, Aug. 26, ending his season. He had been taking most first-team center reps after Tyler Linderbaum's offseason move to the Raiders; Ethan Pocic and Jovaughn Gwyn are the leading options to replace him.

Flowers pulled up with a hamstring injury late in the Sept. 13 win over Indianapolis while on his way to a career day (5 catches, 150 yards, TD). He did not practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17. HC Jesse Minter called him day-to-day and reporting has consistently described the strain as not serious, but two straight non-participations leave Sunday vs. New Orleans in doubt.
ir
Madubuike was ruled out for the Week 1 opener against Indianapolis, with HC Jesse Minter calling him "really, really close." He was back as a limited participant at Wednesday's Week 2 practice.
Buchanan was ruled OUT of the Week 1 opener but was back as a limited participant at Wednesday's Week 2 practice ahead of Sunday vs. New Orleans.

The rookie receiver fractured his wrist in his NFL debut at Indianapolis. Baltimore placed him on injured reserve Wednesday, Sept. 16; he is expected to undergo surgery with the hope he can return in roughly a month.

Hendrickson did not participate in practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17. Baltimore's official report has not specified the injury and no game status has been issued for Sunday vs. New Orleans.

Left Wednesday's joint practice vs. Atlanta clutching his groin and did not return; HC Shane Steichen confirmed the injury. Per NFL insider Jordan Schultz, the Colts avoided a critical injury — Warren is expected to be out roughly a week, not weeks — though he'll be shut down for the rest of camp/preseason as a precaution. Second-year first-round pick coming off a strong rookie season (76 catches, 817 yards, 5 total TDs) and expected to be a lead target for Daniel Jones; trending toward being ready for the regular season.

Pierce did not participate in Thursday's (Sept. 17) practice with a heel injury ahead of Sunday night at Kansas City. He had been activated off the PUP list Sept. 11 following an ankle injury and played in the Week 1 loss at Baltimore.
ir
Originally hurt in an October 2024 collision with Derrick Henry. Placed on reserve/PUP for a second straight season; not expected to play in 2026.
The Browns placed Wright on injured reserve Sunday due to a ruptured Achilles, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
questionable

Sampson hurt the knee returning a kickoff in the Week 1 loss at Jacksonville and was on crutches afterward. Cleveland placed him on injured reserve Tuesday, Sept. 15 and signed Jaleel McLaughlin off the practice squad. He must miss at least four games and is first eligible in Week 6 vs. Baltimore; Mary Kay Cabot of The Plain Dealer reports he is expected back this season. Quinshon Judkins takes over the backfield.

Thomas briefly left Sunday's win over Cleveland before returning, finishing with three catches for 40 yards. HC Liam Coen said Monday that Thomas will be limited in practice this week but that he expects him to play Sunday.

Tagovailoa went down untouched at practice Sept. 10 with an oblique strain and missed the opener at Pittsburgh. He did not practice again on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17. HC Kevin Stefanski said he is 'not ruling anybody out' at quarterback for Sunday's home opener vs. Carolina, but Michael Penix Jr. and Cooper Rush were both full participants and split first-team reps.

Named the Week 1 starter Friday after Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) was ruled out, then dealt with back spasms at Saturday's walkthrough. The Falcons announced he is still expected to start Sunday at Pittsburgh. With Michael Penix Jr. inactive, undrafted rookie Jack Strand would be the only other QB available if Rush cannot go.

Penix has been a full practice participant as he finishes rehab from the Week 11 ACL tear, and he was full again on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17 while splitting first-team reps with Cooper Rush. HC Kevin Stefanski has still not named a Week 2 starter vs. Carolina, with Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) not practicing, so Penix is healthy but the QB job is unsettled.

Carted off during an 11-on-11 period at Tuesday's practice; an MRI later that evening confirmed a torn ACL, per The Athletic's Josh Kendall. The 2025 first-round pick (No. 15 overall) will miss the entire 2026 season.
Bowman (Achilles) was a full participant at practice Wednesday, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
A full participant in practice but still carries a questionable designation on Atlanta's final Week 1 injury report at Pittsburgh.
Hand is believed to have torn a quad in Sunday's loss at Pittsburgh. Atlanta confirmed Monday that he will undergo season-ending surgery on the quad.

The Pro Bowl right guard was diagnosed with a concussion in the Sept. 13 loss at Pittsburgh. He did not practice Wednesday, Sept. 16 but was upgraded to a limited participant Thursday, Sept. 17 - a step in the protocol. He must clear it to play Sunday vs. Carolina.

Activated off the PUP list and returned to practice Monday, Aug. 24, alongside rookie OL Max Iheanachor (neck). HC Mike McCarthy called it a positive step after Ramsey opened camp on PUP with a minicamp knee injury (no surgery required); he's expected to be limited/ramping up gradually. Barring a setback, he's on track to be Pittsburgh's top slot corner for the Sept. 13 regular-season opener vs. Atlanta.

injury.type: Knee injury - reverted to injured reserve
injury.note: Carted off during a non-contact 7-on-7 period at an early padded camp practice. The Steelers waived him with an injury designation; he cleared waivers and reverted to Pittsburgh's injured reserve, likely ending his 2026 season. A 2024 UDFA out of the Bengals' practice squad, he was a depth/roster-bubble receiver - impact score lowered accordingly. Pittsburgh signed WR Jakobie Keeney-James in his place.

Porter was inactive for the Week 1 win at Atlanta because of the back injury; Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport reported at the time that a trade also remained in play amid his summer-long contract dispute. He was a limited participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. New England.
Pittsburgh placed its starting safety on injured reserve, so he must miss at least the first four games. The team has not specified the injury.
Pittman was a limited participant Wednesday, Sept. 16 with a foot injury, then did not practice at all Thursday, Sept. 17 - a step backward ahead of Sunday vs. New England.
Jonathan (thigh) reverted to the Jets' injured reserve Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

Did not practice at any point during Week 1 prep and was ruled OUT for Sunday's opener vs. Tennessee. The Jets then placed him on injured reserve Saturday, Sept. 12, per NFL.com's daily roundup, meaning he must miss at least four games.

The first-round rookie left Sunday's win at Tennessee in the first quarter after a 30-yard catch on the opening drive. X-rays were negative and Monday's MRI came back better than feared. Ian Rapoport reports Cooper is week-to-week with the hope he returns within the next four weeks. Isaiah Williams and Arian Smith absorb the snaps in the meantime.

The five-time Pro Bowl safety, acquired to steady the Jets' secondary, exited Sunday's win over Tennessee after roughly six snaps. An MRI Monday confirmed a groin strain and he is now reported to be facing a two-to-three-week absence, making him unlikely for Week 2 vs. Green Bay.

Evaluated for a concussion after a hard hit from Bears S Xavier Woods in Thursday's joint practice - a hit HC Robert Saleh called "cheap." Ian Rapoport and follow-up reporting indicate Robinson is not believed to have suffered a concussion and is expected to avoid the protocol; Tennessee is still monitoring him in case symptoms develop.
ir

Gray was a full participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17, and Tennessee's Thursday report carried no game designation for him - consistent with having cleared the concussion protocol ahead of Sunday vs. Philadelphia.

The No. 3 overall pick sprained his high ankle in the preseason game vs. Las Vegas and sat out the final two exhibitions. He was limited in all three Week 1 practices and is officially questionable for Sunday at the Chargers. HC Mike LaFleur called him a game-time decision but said he is "trending well"; ESPN's Josh Weinfuss reported Friday that Love is expected to play.
questionable

injury.type: Ankle - on injured reserve (designated to return)
injury.note: Arizona placed Conner on injured reserve with a designation to return on Aug. 30, per Tom Pelissero, as he continues to recover from the dislocated ankle that ended his 2025 season. He must miss at least the first four games (Chargers, Seahawks, 49ers, Giants) and is first eligible to return in Week 5 at Detroit on Oct. 11. With Trey Benson waived in August, rookie Jeremiyah Love and the remaining backs carry the load until Conner is back.

Returned to practice Saturday, Aug. 22 as a limited participant, per HC Jim Harbaugh - his first practice action since missing 8 straight sessions. Worked through individual drills and the first team-drill period before stepping aside; still considered day-to-day, but the return is a positive sign after a knee flare-up in his surgically repaired patellar tendon. No firm timetable yet for a return to full practice.

Officially placed on season-ending injured reserve Aug. 23 after tearing his ACL when a 49ers defensive lineman fell into his leg during an Aug. 18 joint practice. Signed with the Chargers in March on a 3-year, $30M deal after playing for Washington last season; Chargers will turn to their backup center options for the year.
Campbell (leg) reverted to the Chargers' injured reserve list Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
Limited in practice and listed as questionable on the Chargers' final Week 1 injury report for Sunday's opener vs. Arizona.

McConkey took a hard hit in the third quarter of the Sept. 13 loss to Arizona. HC Jim Harbaugh called him day-to-day, but he did not practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. Las Vegas.
The Chargers placed Lambert-Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.

The rookie tight end was a limited participant in practice all week with a calf injury, but Miami issued no game-status designations on its final Week 1 report and Kacmarek told reporters he plans to play Sunday at Las Vegas.
Tolbert (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
The rookie linebacker sprained his MCL in Miami's Week 1 loss to Las Vegas and is expected to miss a few weeks.

Helped off the field Aug. 23 with a sprain that Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter described as "more low than high" and not long-term; Las Vegas never placed him on IR. He was a FULL participant with no injury designation on the Wednesday, Sept. 9 report, clearing the rookie-year workhorse for the Sept. 13 opener vs. Miami.

The third-round rookie was hurt in the third quarter of the preseason finale vs. the 49ers after being pushed down and landing awkwardly. Initially reported as an ankle injury when Las Vegas placed him on IR at cutdown; HC Klint Kubiak later confirmed it is an Achilles injury that will cost Crawford his entire rookie season.

Bowers had a meniscus trim on Sept. 8 and missed the Week 1 win over Miami. He did not practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17, despite HC Klint Kubiak saying he hoped to get him on the field Thursday or Friday. ESPN's Dan Graziano reported the injury is not overly serious with a Week 2 return at the Chargers still possible. Michael Mayer handles the TE work if he sits.
ir
Porter did not practice Wednesday, Sept. 16 as Las Vegas opened Week 2 prep for the Chargers.

injury.type: Torn ACL + meniscus repair (left knee) - on reserve/PUP
injury.note: Suffered a torn ACL plus meniscus repair in Week 15 last season vs. Denver. Green Bay made it official with Sunday's cutdown, moving Parsons from active/PUP to reserve/PUP, which rules him out of the first four games (vs. Minnesota, the Jets, Atlanta and Tampa Bay) and makes Week 5 the earliest he can return. Parsons has said his 'most optimistic' target is Week 6 (Oct. 18, SNF vs. his old team the Cowboys at Lambeau), but stressed there's no guarantee given the Packers' internal recovery protocol for ACL-plus injuries.

The NFL placed Jacobs on the Commissioner's Exempt List on Sunday, Aug. 30, three days after he was formally charged with misdemeanor battery and criminal damage to property stemming from an alleged May incident. He is not on Green Bay's 53-man roster and cannot practice or attend games, though he continues to be paid. His initial court appearance has been moved up from Nov. 17 to Thursday, Sept. 10, per Michael Gross of Fox 11 Green Bay; Jacobs is expected to be represented by his attorney and will not appear personally. The league does not have to wait for the legal process to conclude before issuing discipline. The Packers acquired RB Kaleb Johnson from Pittsburgh amid the uncertainty. His earlier August groin strain is no longer the reason for his absence.

New to Green Bay's camp injury report in early August with a sprained foot. Coach Matt LaFleur says he's hopeful Reed will be ready for the Sept. 7 season opener vs. Detroit, though the team is proceeding cautiously with the soft-tissue issue.
The Packers placed Williams (undisclosed) on injured reserve Sunday with a designation to return, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.
Banks was inactive for the Week 1 loss to Minnesota with the knee injury but was back as a limited participant at Wednesday's Week 2 practice ahead of Sunday at the Jets.
Van Ness was added to Green Bay's report Wednesday, Sept. 16 in the concussion protocol and was a limited participant Thursday, Sept. 17 ahead of Sunday vs. the Jets.

Murray took a hit to the head while sliding in the Sept. 13 win over Green Bay and entered the concussion protocol. He was a limited participant in practice on both Wednesday, Sept. 16 and Thursday, Sept. 17; HC Kevin O'Connell said he wants Murray cleared by Friday to play Sunday at Chicago. Carson Wentz starts if he is not cleared.
Returned to practice July 29 after a mild hamstring strain; fully participated with no limitations in Sunday's (Aug. 9) public training camp practice. On track for Week 1 vs. Chicago.

Adams went down without contact in coverage during the Aug. 15 preseason game at the Giants and was carted off. Testing confirmed a torn right quad tendon and Minnesota placed him on injured reserve Aug. 17, ending his season.
Jefferson (undisclosed) reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
The NFL suspended Jones three games Tuesday for violating the league's substance-abuse policy, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
Fleming (undisclosed) reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve list Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injury.type: Fractured right thumb - surgery, on injured reserve
injury.note: Mason reported thumb soreness Monday after the opener against Green Bay; the thumb was fractured and he underwent surgery. Minnesota placed him on injured reserve Wednesday, Sept. 16, so he must miss at least four games, though HC Kevin O'Connell is hopeful he returns at that point. The Vikings promoted DeeJay Dallas and signed Jerome Ford to the practice squad.

Hurt in a one-on-one pass-rush rep vs. Odafe Oweh during Saturday's practice; underwent surgery to repair the torn triceps. HC Dan Quinn didn't disclose an exact timeline, but recovery from this type of injury typically runs 4-7 months, likely sidelining him for most if not all of the 2026 season. Washington moved Brandon Coleman to left tackle in his place, with Andrew Wylie as depth; Quinn said the team isn't looking outside the building for additional O-line help.
questionable
Burks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
Okonkwo did not practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17. HC Dan Quinn said he would know more later in the week about his availability for Sunday at Dallas.
Washington placed Newton on injured reserve with a pectoral injury; reporting points to a return around November.

Luvu did not return after halftime of the Sept. 13 loss at Philadelphia. ESPN reported the strain is minor and injured reserve is not expected, but he did not practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17 and HC Dan Quinn said his status for Sunday at Dallas is still uncertain.
Greenard missed the opener against Washington with the pectoral injury but returned as a limited participant at Wednesday's Week 2 practice ahead of Sunday at Tennessee.

Back at practice this week in a limited/individual-drills capacity as the Eagles ramp him up ahead of joint sessions with New England; team says the hamstring issue is not serious and there's no long-term concern, though a firm return-to-full timetable still hasn't been set.
Wilson (knee) reverted to Philadelphia's injured reserve Saturday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injury.type: Knee - bone bruise (right), on injured reserve
injury.note: The three-time Pro Bowl left guard sustained a bone bruise in his right knee when he was rolled up on at a training-camp practice and tried to play through it in Sunday's 24-22 win over Washington. Philadelphia placed him on injured reserve Monday, Sept. 14, so he must miss at least four games. Dickerson said on WIP that he played poorly in the opener and should not be out there until he feels healthy.

The All-Pro defensive tackle did not practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17 with a wrist injury after playing 66 snaps in the Week 1 win over Washington. Reporting has suggested these may be maintenance days; CB Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) also sat out both days and said he expects to play Sunday at Tennessee.

Broke his left forearm in Friday's (Aug. 28) preseason game against the Saints, HC Brian Schottenheimer confirmed. Per ESPN, Liufau is scheduled for surgery as early as Monday, Aug. 31, putting the Sept. 13 opener in serious doubt for the third-year linebacker.

injury.type: Thumb ligament injury - surgery, headed to injured reserve
injury.note: HC Brian Schottenheimer said Monday, Sept. 7 that the three-time Pro Bowl left guard will have surgery on a thumb ligament and is expected to miss four to six weeks; Dallas is placing him on injured reserve. Smith had been playing through the issue but it was affecting his grip strength. T.J. Bass replaces him at left guard, with a Week 5 or Week 6 return the target.

Hooker left Sunday night's loss to the Giants with a forearm injury after one tackle, and testing confirmed a fracture. He is consulting specialists about which bone is involved to set a recovery timeline; some forearm fractures cost players about six weeks, though Dallas is hopeful for a quicker return.
HC Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Overshown is expected to miss one to two weeks with a hamstring injury suffered in the Sept. 13 loss at the Giants.

Nabers tore his ACL and meniscus in Week 4 of 2025 and had a second cleanup procedure this summer to remove scar tissue. He was listed questionable for the Sept. 13 opener but played, catching six of nine targets for 69 yards in the win over Dallas. He is expected to keep carrying a spot on the injury report as the Giants manage his workload.

Carted off Tuesday's (Aug. 25) practice after his knee buckled running a route; Adam Schefter initially reported a "serious knee injury" and a source confirmed to ESPN on Wednesday, Aug. 26 that it is a torn ACL that will cost him the 2026 season. Austin, 27 and in a contract year, had been in line for a significant role in New York's passing game - a bigger blow with Malik Nabers still working back from his own ACL tear.
Tracy missed time Wednesday, Sept. 16 with an illness, per Jordan Raanan of ESPN, but he was off New York's Thursday, Sept. 17 injury report entirely ahead of Monday night at the Rams.

The NFL placed Cooper on the Commissioner's Exempt List while it reviews domestic-violence charges stemming from two June arrests in Parker, Colo., including a felony second-degree assault by strangulation count. He continues to be paid and may attend meetings and work out at the facility, but cannot practice or attend games. Cooper has posted at least eight sacks in each of the last three seasons (career-high 10.5 in 2024). No return timetable.

Mims played through the foot injury in the Week 1 loss at Kansas City, returning two punts for 36 yards without drawing a target. He did not participate in practice on either Wednesday, Sept. 16 or Thursday, Sept. 17, so his status for Sunday vs. Jacksonville is unsettled.

Mahomes has been a full participant throughout camp following December 2025 ACL/LCL surgery, and Kansas City reported NO INJURIES on its first official Week 1 report, Wednesday, Sept. 9 - clearing him without designation for the Monday, Sept. 14 opener vs. Denver.

Caldwell (knee) reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list Tuesday, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.

Kansas City's starting left tackle and 2025 first-round pick has missed more than three weeks with a lower back injury suffered in training camp. He did not practice all week and the Chiefs officially ruled him out Saturday for Monday night's opener vs. Denver; undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson is set to make his first NFL start in his place.

The first-round rookie intercepted Bo Nix on the third play of his NFL debut Monday night, then left during Denver's next possession and was ruled out. X-rays and a CT scan were negative and he had an MRI Tuesday; Mike Garafolo reported the shoulder is stable and the belief is he misses minimal time. Delane dealt with a hairline scapula fracture in the spring.
